name: Intrusive Despair
summary: No save to cast: each time the cursed creature takes the Attack or Magic action it makes a Wis save or wastes the action. The spell ends after its third success.
text: You curse a creature within 90 feet, filling its mind with creeping paranoia and despair. There is no saving throw when you cast it. Whenever the target takes the Attack action or the Magic action it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or waste that action. Once the target has succeeded on three of these saves, the spell ends. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
